resources.title: The BEST Way To Aim Train in CS2 (2026)
resources.creator: WilsonCS2
resources.noteEs: WilsonCS2 entrega la rutina de aim training actualizada para 2026: qué workshop maps usar, en qué orden, cuánto tiempo dedicar a cada uno, y qué métricas tienen sentido vs cuáles son ruido. Anchor del cluster aim-improvement.
resources.noteEn: WilsonCS2 delivers the aim training routine updated for 2026: which workshop maps to use, in what order, how much time to spend on each, and which metrics make sense vs. which are noise. Anchor of the aim-improvement cluster.

resources.title: The GREATEST CS2 Warm Up Guide OF ALL TIME (in under 11 minutes)
resources.creator: Biley
resources.noteEs: El warm-up correcto antes de jugar Premier o FACEIT marca diferencia consistente — Biley estructura una rutina de 10-15 min que combina aim, movement y reflexes. Específicamente para warm-up pre-session, no para sesiones largas de training.
resources.noteEn: The correct warm-up before playing Premier or FACEIT makes a consistent difference — Biley structures a 10-15 min routine combining aim, movement, and reflexes. Specifically for pre-session warm-up, not long training sessions.

resources.title: How I Keep My Aim Sharp at 37 | CS2 Aim Routine (Beginner Friendly 2026)
resources.creator: no_ctrl CS2
resources.noteEs: Approach distinto: no_ctrl, player adulto que mantiene aim competitivo a los 37, comparte rutina sostenible más que intensa. Útil para players que no tienen 2-3 horas diarias para training pero quieren progress consistente con 20 minutos al día.
resources.noteEn: Different approach: no_ctrl, an adult player keeping competitive aim at 37, shares a sustainable rather than intense routine. Useful for players who don't have 2-3 hours a day for training but want consistent progress with 20 minutes daily.

resources.title: 8 AJUSTES QUE ESTAN ARRUINANDO TU AIM EN CS2
resources.creator: Jotun
resources.noteEs: Antes de invertir horas en aim training, conviene asegurar que los ajustes (sensibilidad, DPI, crosshair, raw input, etc.) no estén saboteando el aim. Jotun lista 8 settings comunes mal configurados en bajo elo. Anchor en español, fix-first-then-train mindset.
resources.noteEn: Before investing hours in aim training, it's worth ensuring settings (sensitivity, DPI, crosshair, raw input, etc.) aren't sabotaging your aim. Jotun lists 8 commonly miscalibrated settings in low elo. Spanish anchor with a fix-first-then-train mindset.

resources.title: Por Qué No Tienes Una Puntería Tranquila
resources.creator: Znorux
resources.noteEs: Znorux toma el ángulo mental del aim: por qué tu puntería se vuelve errática bajo presión y cómo desarrollar 'aim tranquilo' que no se desmorona en clutches. 16 minutos en español que combinan biomechanics y mindset — más profundo que las rutinas tradicionales.
resources.noteEn: Znorux takes the mental angle of aim: why your aim becomes erratic under pressure and how to develop 'calm aim' that doesn't crumble in clutches. 16 minutes in Spanish combining biomechanics and mindset — deeper than traditional routines.
